facts.text: Caroline attended an LGBTQ+ pride parade last week, which made her feel like she belonged and showed her how much the community has grown.

evidence.quote: Since we last spoke, some big things have happened. Last week I went to an LGBTQ+ pride parade. Everyone was so happy and it made me feel like I belonged. It showed me how much our community has grown, it was amazing!

facts.text: Caroline's experience at the LGBTQ+ pride parade motivated her to consider using her story to help others through counseling and mental health.

evidence.quote: It really motivated me for sure. Talking to the community made me want to use my story to help others too - I'm still thinking that counseling and mental health is the way to go.

facts.text: Melanie signed up for a pottery class yesterday, describing it as therapy that allows her to express herself and get creative.

evidence.quote: I just signed up for a pottery class yesterday. It's like therapy for me, letting me express myself and get creative.

facts.text: Caroline mentioned she is learning the piano as a way to express herself creatively, similar to Melanie's pottery class.

evidence.quote: I'm getting creative too, just learning the piano.
